explanation: The loop starts at `i = 1` instead of `i = 0`, so the first element (`arr[0]`) is never copied, and the condition `i <= arr.length` lets the loop run one iteration too far, pushing `arr[arr.length]` (which is `undefined`) onto the result. It should be `for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++)`.
